hypothesis: Explicit shape regimes may capture kernel-dependent instruction costs missed by polynomial work estimates. The two remaining regimes—medium initial chunks and small temporal chunks—have similar observed total costs and share the fitted baseline.

pcvs.name: initial_small_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Separates initial chunks below the medium spatial size into their own execution regime.

pcvs.name: initial_large_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Separates large initial chunks, whose instruction scaling remains poorly explained by area.

pcvs.name: temporal_medium_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independent cost for medium spatial inputs with multiple temporal frames.

pcvs.name: temporal_large_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independent cost for large spatial inputs with multiple temporal frames.
